sources.title: RFC 3032: MPLS Label Stack Encoding
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: RSVP-TE：頻寬保留與可行路徑
related.titleEn: RSVP-TE: bandwidth reservations and feasible paths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受單一正確BoS且總長1472/1480 B；不能在不同路由器間假設相同label代表同一FEC。 交接時須能核對：交付 label-stack.csv、位元欄位圖與提早BoS反例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require a single correct BoS and1472/1480 B totals; equal labels at different routers need not identify the same FEC. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver label-stack.csv, bit-field diagrams and a premature-BoS counterexample.
related.difference: 建立逐鏈路capacity、reserved、request、remaining表，不只檢查路徑平均。
related.differenceEn: Build capacity, reserved, request and remaining columns per link rather than checking a path average.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
每個MPLS label stack entry佔4 B，Bottom-of-Stack標示最後一層；標籤值是局部意義。
教學基準：1460+3*4 = 1472 B；對照：1460+5*4 = 1480 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

RSVP-TE路徑需同時滿足拓撲與資源限制；鏈路速率不是可立即保留頻寬。
教學基準：min(100-30-40,100-55-40) = 5 Mb/s；對照：min(100-30-50,100-55-50) = -5 Mb/s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Each MPLS stack entry occupies4 B, and Bottom-of-Stack marks the last entry; label values are locally significant.
Teaching baseline: 1460+3*4 = 1472 B; comparison: 1460+5*4 = 1480 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

RSVP-TE paths must satisfy topology and resource constraints; line rate is not currently reservable bandwidth.
Teaching baseline: min(100-30-40,100-55-40) = 5 Mb/s; comparison: min(100-30-50,100-55-50) = -5 Mb/s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: DNSSEC: signature time windows versus trust validation

related.difference: 建立RRset、key tag、signer、inception、expiration與觀測時鐘欄，不實作假簽章驗證。
related.differenceEn: Record RRset, key tag, signer, inception, expiration and observed clock without pretending to implement signature verification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

DNSSEC驗證包含簽章、信任鏈與有效時間；通過時間檢查不足以證明真偽。
教學基準：1700003600-1700001200 = 2400 s；對照：1700003600-1700003700 = -100 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
